title: 🎄 Kubernetes Security Masterclass Challenges
description: A series of hands-on, CTF-style Kubernetes security challenges. Take on the role of the Senior Security Elf and defend the North Pole cluster against the rogue elf faction! Challenges progress from Easy to Hard, covering secrets management, container hardening, Helm chart security, and Kyverno policy enforcement.

items.title: 🟢 Challenge 1: The Exposed Coordinates
items.description: Difficulty: Easy • ~15 min • Topics: Kubernetes Secrets, Helm, Volume Mounts — The Sleigh Routing API is leaking the Master Guidance Coordinates through a plaintext env var. Refactor the Helm chart to securely mount the secret as a file.

items.title: 🟡 Challenge 2: The Bloated Sleigh Image
items.description: Difficulty: Medium • ~25 min • Topics: Dockerfile, Multi-Stage Builds, Non-Root Containers — The rogue elves shipped a 1GB+ container image running as root. Rewrite the Dockerfile to produce a secure, slim (<250MB) image using multi-stage builds.

items.title: 🔴 Challenge 3: The Trojan Helm Chart
items.description: Difficulty: Hard • ~40 min • Topics: Helm, Kyverno, Security Context, RBAC, Probes — The rogue elves submitted a misconfigured Helm chart. Fix all 6+ Kyverno policy violations to meet North Pole production standards.
